results.change_intent: Display local service flags in the -netinfo dashboard, formatting them as a list for the summary view and as service characters in the header when details are requested.
results.summary: A temporary std::string from strprintf is bound to a std::string_view, creating a dangling view and leading to undefined behavior.

issues.comment: `strprintf` returns a temporary `std::string`. Binding it to `std::string_view` causes `services` to reference destroyed storage as soon as the temporary is deallocated at the end of the statement, resulting in undefined behavior when `services` is read on the next line.
issues.suggestion: Declare `services` as `const std::string` instead of `const std::string_view` so its lifetime extends across the subsequent `strprintf` call.
